mapper.select: SELECT id,sku_id,quantity FROM rental_order_item WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE order_evidence_record SET issue_report_id=#{issueId} WHERE id=#{id} AND rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND issue_report_id IS NULL

UPDATE order_receipt_check SET
remaining_check_ms=COALESCE(remaining_check_ms,GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,GREATEST(start_at,#{at}),deadline_at) DIV 1000),43200000), check_status='problem_reported',deadline_at=NULL,
version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{checkId} AND version=#{version} AND check_status IN ('pending','problem_reported')
UPDATE rental_order_delivery d JOIN order_receipt_check c ON c.rental_order_id=d.rental_order_id SET d.receipt_check_deadline_at=c.deadline_at,d.updated_at=#{at} WHERE d.rental_order_id=#{orderId}
UPDATE rental_order SET version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{orderId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT rental_order_id FROM order_receipt_check WHERE check_status='problem_reported' AND remaining_check_ms IS NOT NULL AND rental_order_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY rental_order_id LIMIT 100
